claims.summary: In Homo sapiens, MACROPHAGE is marked by CD68.

claims.span_literal: Calvarial osteoprogenitors highly expressed COL1A1, PRRX2 and CLEC11A, a recently identified osteogenic factor that promotes the maintenance of adult skeleton.
claims.summary: In Homo sapiens, OSTEOPROGENITOR is marked by COL1A1. In Homo sapiens, OSTEOPROGENITOR is marked by PRRX2. In Homo sapiens, OSTEOPROGENITOR is marked by CLEC11A.

claims.span_literal: Although no calvarial subset highly resembled long bone eSSPC at the transcriptome level, we found that NCDC shared similar phenotypic markers to long bone eSSPC (PDGFRA^(low/-)PDPN+CADM1+) (Fig. 6d), which located in between mig_NC cells and osteoprogenitors (Fig. 6a).
claims.summary: In Homo sapiens, NEURAL CREST-DERIVED CELL is marked by CADM1. In Homo sapiens, NEURAL CREST-DERIVED CELL is marked by PDPN.
